questions.section: Part two: structured questions (60 marks)
questions.question:
41. Verify the following identity.
  a. (sinx + cosx)² = 1 + sin2x (3 marks)
  b. Cosx tanx = sinx (1 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
a. LHS = sin²x + 2 sinx cosx + cos²x = (sin²x + cos²x) + 2 sinx cosx = 1 + sin 2x = RHS ∎
b. cosx · (sinx / cosx) = sinx ∎

42.
  a. Expand Sin (A+B). (2marks)
  b. Tan (A-B) (2 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
a. sin(A + B) = sinA cosB + cosA sinB
b. tan(A − B) = (tanA − tanB) / (1 + tanA tanB)

questions.question: 47. A bag contains 8 black balls and 5 white ones. If two balls are picked from the bag one at a time, find the probability of getting a white ball and a black ball without replacement. (4 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
P(one white and one black, in either order) = (5/13 × 8/12) + (8/13 × 5/12) = 40/156 + 40/156 = 80/156 = 20/39
(If the order “white then black” is meant: 5/13 × 8/12 = 10/39.)

55. Evaluate the following integrals
  a. ∫(x² + x + 3) dx (2 marks)
  b. Find the area of the region bounded by the curve y = 2x², the lines x = 1, x = 4 and the x-axis. (3marks)

diagram.caption: Parabola through the origin with the area under the curve shaded between x = 1 and x = 4 (the printed figure labels the curve y = x²).

questions.answer_guide:
a. x³/3 + x²/2 + 3x + c
b. Area = ∫₁⁴ 2x² dx = [2x³/3]₁⁴ = (128 − 2)/3 = 42 square units
(The figure is labelled y = x²; with y = x² the area would be 21 square units.)
